title: How Does Continued Use of Green Light Therapy Impact Outcomes?
official: How Does Continued Use of Green Light Therapy Impact Outcomes?
summary: Already using Green Light Therapy? Explore how continued use with twice-weekly 20-minute sessions may continue to support positive changes in body composition. Discover whether this non-invasive wellness approach gets better over time to help support energy, balance, and renewal.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Can read and understand English.
* US resident.
* Willing and able to follow the requirements of the protocol.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals with eye conditions
* Individuals not active with Green Light Therapy
